rigClassScale.note: medium = this file (FrizzleBob v5b / Rig_Medium seated in 02: body and head inside, ears poke through the roof - allowed, V-321). large = PROPOSAL only, re-derived vs the v3 base with the v2 method: Orc Brute (Rig_Large) needs the car x1.70 larger again (smallest x2.545 of v1 with head >= 5 cm under the roof in 02, 2.545/1.50 = 1.697, rounded up)

seat_fit.pose: KayKit Character Animations 1.1 · Rig_Medium_Simulation.glb · Sit_Chair_Idle @1.0 s
seat_fit.placement: pelvis x/z on kfb_driver_hidden, facing +Z; lowest foot on the hull floor (raycast down from kfb_driver_hidden)
seat_fit.method: three.js Raycaster against the 100k-tri browser hull (same seat.js as v2): inside = first hit upward is an exit face; ears measured separately (height above the outer hull surface, ray down from above)
seat_fit.criteria: V-321: body and head (without ears) inside, shoulders inside the side walls, hips above the floor; ears may fold or poke through the roof
seat_fit.note: same factor applied to all 11 racers (relative sizes kept); only 02 is measured. Ears: WS1 may bend ear.l/r.1-3 while driving (hop-in-hidden hides the figure anyway)

stickers_v2.method: logo areas projected from ortho views onto the mesh and repainted in UV space (base colour WebP 2048; normal flattened, metal/rough levelled under the patch)
